title: Levenaer
description: The skies of Altura are filled with the great floating aerlands. These marvels of humanities will to survive are grown from a native microorganism known as coral. They float on a cloud sea, each one anchored to one of the many great towers that pierce through the golden mists.

title: Levendom
description: Levendom is one of the many domed cities crouching at the base of the Altura’s great and ancient towers.

title: Manorface
description: A militarized, government-controlled district on the southern face of the tower. Reserved for the Governor’s regiment and off-limits to most domers. This is the Aerlands seat of power within the Domes.

title: Or’wid Way
description: A main ore-hauling road from The Pits to the tower’s southern cargo yards

title: The Pits
description: A massive terraced open-pit mine in the southwestern quadrant of the dome. Full of shaft mouths, carts, and steaming ore lifts

title: The Tower
description: An ancient, seamless vertical structure (former colony ship) at the center of Levendom. It pierces the dome and extends far above. Used for freight, lifts, and symbolic separation between classes

title: The Twix
description: A gang-dominated, narrow, winding warren of alleys northwest and west of the tower. Ill-lit and full of coded lanterns marking brothels, bathhouses, and gang territories
